63990-palimpsest.title: Palimpsest
63990-palimpsest.creator: Unknown
63990-palimpsest.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Somehow Hanlon had wormed his way into their quarters and was waiting when Geddes and Lowe and Hovic, crew of the _Terra IV_, returned to base from their final interview with the press. Hanlon had been drunk for days, and was in pitiable condition. His hand shook violently and the bloodshot shine of his eyes was like a reflection to the fiery red of his unkempt hair.

arxiv-1702-04604.title: Quark model study of the π ​ N → π ​ N \pi N\to\pi N reactions up to the N ⁡ ( 1440 ) N(1440) resonance region
arxiv-1702-04604.creator: Kai-Lei Wang, Li-Ye Xiao, Xian-Hui Zhong
arxiv-1702-04604.description: Abstract A combined analysis of the reactions π + ​ p → π + ​ p \pi^{+}p\to\pi^{+}p , π − ​ p → π − ​ p \pi^{-}p\to\pi^{-}p and π − ​ p → π 0 ​ n \pi^{-}p\to\pi^{0}n is carried out with a chiral quark model.

arxiv-2111-09976.title: M2A: Motion Aware Attention for Accurate Video Action Recognition
arxiv-2111-09976.creator: Brennan Gebotys, Alexander Wong, David A. Clausi
arxiv-2111-09976.description: Abstract Advancements in attention mechanisms have led to significant performance improvements in a variety of areas in machine learning due to its ability to enable the dynamic modeling of temporal sequences. A particular area in computer vision that is likely to benefit greatly from the incorporation of attention mechanisms in video action recognition.

arxiv-2303-07753.title: A functorial approach to monomorphism categories II: Indecomposables
arxiv-2303-07753.creator: Nan Gao, Julian Külshammer, Sondre Kvamme, Chrysostomos Psaroudakis
arxiv-2303-07753.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Nan Gao, Julian Külshammer, Sondre Kvamme, Chrysostomos Psaroudakis. We investigate the (separated) monomorphism category mono ⁡ ( Q , Λ ) \operatorname{mono}(Q,\Lambda) of a quiver over an Artin algebra Λ \Lambda . We show that there exists an epivalence (called representation equivalence in the terminology of Auslander) from mono ¯ ​ ( Q , Λ ) \overline{\operatorname{mono}}(Q,\Lambda) to rep ⁡ ( Q , mod ¯ ​ Λ ) \operatorname{rep}(Q,\overline{\operatorname{mod}}\,\Lambda) , where mod ⁡ Λ \operatorname{mod}\Lambda is the category of finitely generated Λ \Lambda -modules

arxiv-2305-10148.title: Stability analysis of two-dimensional ideal flows with applications to viscous fluids and plasmas
arxiv-2305-10148.creator: Diogo Arsénio, Haroune Houamed
arxiv-2305-10148.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Diogo Arsénio, Haroune Houamed. We are interested in the stability analysis of two-dimensional incompressible inviscid fluids. Specifically, we revisit a known recent result on the stability of Yudovich’s solutions to the incompressible Euler equations in L ∞ ​ ( [ 0 , T ] , H 1 ) L^{\infty}([0,T];H^{1}) by providing a new approach to its proof based on the idea of compactness extrapolation and by extending it to the whole plane.

arxiv-2401-00670.title: Hybrid physics-informed metabolic cybergenetics: process rates augmented with machine-learning surrogates informed by flux balance analysis
arxiv-2401-00670.creator: Sebastián Espinel-Ríos, José L. Avalos
arxiv-2401-00670.description: Abstract Metabolic cybergenetics is a promising concept that interfaces gene expression and cellular metabolism with computers for real-time dynamic metabolic control. The focus is on control at the transcriptional level, serving as a means to modulate intracellular metabolic fluxes. Recent strategies in this field have employed constraint-based dynamic models for process optimization, control, and estimation.

arxiv-2402-09689.title: Lense-Thirring Precession after a Supermassive Black Hole Disrupts a Star
arxiv-2402-09689.creator: Dheeraj R. Pasham, Michal Zajaček, C.J. Nixon, Eric R. Coughlin, Marzena Śniegowska, Agnieszka Janiuk, Bożena Czerny, Thomas Wevers, Muryel Guolo, Yukta Ajay, Michael Loewenstein
arxiv-2402-09689.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Dheeraj R. Pasham, Michal Zajaček, C.J. Nixon, Eric R. Coughlin, Marzena Śniegowska, Agnieszka Janiuk, Bożena Czerny, Thomas Wevers, Muryel Guolo, Yukta Ajay, Michael Loewenstein. An accretion disk formed around a supermassive black hole (SMBH) after it disrupts a star is expected to be initially misaligned with respect to the black hole’s equatorial plane.

arxiv-2404-09113.title: Extending Mean-Field Variational Inference via Entropic Regularization: Theory and Computation
arxiv-2404-09113.creator: Bohan Wu bw2766@columbia.edu, David M. Blei david.blei@columbia.edu
arxiv-2404-09113.description: Abstract Variational inference (VI) has emerged as a popular method for approximate inference for high-dimensional Bayesian models. In this paper, we propose a novel VI method that extends the naive mean field via entropic regularization, referred to as Ξ \Xi -variational inference ( Ξ \Xi -VI).

arxiv-2405-07855.title: Formation of N–bearing complex organic molecules in molecular clouds: Ketenimine, acetonitrile, acetaldimine, and vinylamine via the UV photolysis of C 2 H 2 ice
arxiv-2405-07855.creator: K.-J. Chuang, C. Jäger, J. C. Santos, Th. Henning
arxiv-2405-07855.description: Abstract Context. The solid-state C 2 H 2 chemistry in interstellar H 2 O-rich ice has been proposed to explain astronomically observed complex organic molecules (COMs), including ketene (CH 2 CO), acetaldehyde (CH 3 CHO), and ethanol (CH 3 CH 2 OH), toward early star-forming regions.

arxiv-2411-09032.title: Proca stars in excited states
arxiv-2411-09032.creator: Carlos Joaquin, Miguel Alcubierre
arxiv-2411-09032.description: Abstract In this paper, we consider families of solutions for excited states of Proca stars in spherical symmetry. We focus on the first two excited configurations and perform a series of fully non-linear dynamical simulations in order to study their properties and stability.

arxiv-2502-00531.title: Radial Gradients and Intrinsic Scatter in MaNGA Galaxies
arxiv-2502-00531.creator: Tathagata Pal, Guy Worthey
arxiv-2502-00531.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Tathagata Pal, Guy Worthey. We derive stellar population parameters and radial gradients within 0.65 R e for spatially resolved spectra of 2968 early-type galaxies from MaNGA, spanning stellar velocity dispersions ( σ \sigma ) of 50–340 km s -1 . Light weighted mean age, C, N, Na, Mg and Fe abundances are obtained by inverting metallicity–composite stellar population models with isochrones that respond in T eff T{\rm{}_{eff}} to individual element abundance changes.

arxiv-2503-13178.title: Rapfi: Distilling Efficient Neural Network for the Game of Gomoku
arxiv-2503-13178.creator: Zhanggen Jin, Haobin Duan, Zhiyang Hang
arxiv-2503-13178.description: Abstract Games have played a pivotal role in advancing artificial intelligence, with AI agents using sophisticated techniques to compete. Despite the success of neural network based game AIs, their performance often requires significant computational resources. In this paper, we present Rapfi , an efficient Gomoku agent that outperforms CNN-based agents in limited computation environments.

arxiv-2510-17400.title: Tropical super Gromov-Witten invariants
arxiv-2510-17400.creator: Artan Sheshmani 1,2, Shing-Tung Yau 1,3, Benjamin Zhou 3
arxiv-2510-17400.description: Abstract . We show that super Gromov-Witten invariants can be defined and computed by methods of tropical geometry. When the target is a point, the super invariants are descendant invariants on the moduli space of curves, which can be computed tropically.

arxiv-2511-11832.title: Sums of Laurent series with bounded partial quotients
arxiv-2511-11832.creator: Dmitry Gayfulin, Erez Nesharim
arxiv-2511-11832.description: Abstract Hall [ 4 ] proved that every real number is the sum of an integer and two real numbers whose partial quotients are at most 4 4 . Cusick [ 2 ] proved that every real number is the sum of an integer and two real numbers whose partial quotients are at least 2 2 .

pmc-10640963.title: Antibiotic prescription for outpatients with influenza and subsequent hospitalisation: A cohort study using insurance data
pmc-10640963.creator: Hiroshi Yokomichi, Mie Mochizuki, Joseph Jonathan Lee, Reiji Kojima, Sayaka Horiuchi, Tadao Ooka, Zentaro Yamagata
pmc-10640963.description: BackgroundWhether prophylactic administration of antibiotics to patients with influenza reduces the hospitalisation risk is unknown. We aimed to examine the association between antibiotic prescription in outpatients with influenza infection and subsequent hospitalisation.MethodsWe conducted a cohort study using health insurance records of Japanese clinic and hospital visits between 2012 and 2016.

pmc-11415148.title: Battle of the Gases: How Air and Nitrous Oxide Affect Endotracheal Tube Cuff Pressure During General Anesthesia
pmc-11415148.creator: Aparna Bagle, Abhishek Raj, Shivangi Gaur, Chandrakala Singh, Amala Kale
pmc-11415148.description: BackgroundEndotracheal tube (ETT) cuff pressure changes during general anesthesia. Endotracheal cuff pressure ideally should be maintained between 20 and 30 cm of H2O. Cuff pressure of less than 25 cm of H2O increases the chances of aspiration while pressure of more than 40 cm of H2O causes tracheal mucosa damage.

pmc-11517912.title: Exploring the mental health impact of asylum-seeking of sexual minority men: a qualitative study
pmc-11517912.creator: M Gottvall, R Isaac, T Carlsson
pmc-11517912.description: BackgroundSexual minority individuals, often called LGBTQ+, encounter significant danger and violence in some countries worldwide. This forces many to seek asylum in a range of European countries. The study aimed to explore the experiences of seeking asylum and its implications for the mental health of sexual minority forced migrant men in Sweden.

pmc-11657012.title: Clinical Utility of Neurophysiologic Classification (and Declassification) of Myoclonus
pmc-11657012.creator: Marcus N Callister, Molly C Klanderman, Alyssa Stockard, Charles Van Der Walt, Ashley B Pena, John N Caviness
pmc-11657012.description: BackgroundMovement clinical neurophysiology studies can distinguish myoclonus, tremor, and other jerky movements; however, there has been limited demonstration of their real‐world clinical impact.ObjectiveThe aim was to investigate movement study utility in clarifying movement classification and guiding patient management.MethodA retrospective study of myoclonus‐related movement studies was performed.

pmc-11814392.title: 蛋白质翻译后修饰在不明原因复发性流产中的作用
pmc-11814392.creator: 倩倩 高, 佳杰 任, 丁忍 牛, 鲁秦 郭, 晓玲 冯
pmc-11814392.description: 不明原因复发性流产(unexplained recurrent pregnancy loss，URPL)的病理机制复杂，是困扰育龄期女性的常见病。蛋白质翻译后修饰(post-translational modifications，PTMs)作为表观遗传学的主要内容之一，不仅能够调节蛋白质表达、增加其多样性，还能调控蛋白质与其他分子间相互作用。PTMs在URPL的发生、发展中发挥重要作用：如甲基化修饰可阻碍蜕膜化进程，调控滋养细胞迁移和侵袭；磷酸化修饰可调控调节性T细胞(regulatory T cells，Treg)/辅助性T细胞17(T helper 17 cells，Th17)平衡，巨噬细胞极化，改变树突状细胞数量，促进滋养细胞凋亡；乙酰化修饰可诱发滋养细胞自噬，抑制M2型巨噬细胞极化；泛素化修饰可调控滋养细胞迁移和侵袭，干扰免疫微环境；糖基化修饰可抑制滋养层细胞迁移和侵袭；乳酸化修饰可维持子宫内膜容受性。PTMs在URPL中的作用可能使其成为URPL的研究切入点和治疗靶点。 复发性流产(recurrent pregnancy loss，RPL)指与同一性伴侣连续发生流产2次或2次以上，发病率为1%~2%[1]，严重影响育龄期女性的身心健康及其家庭幸福。RPL病因复杂，现已知有遗传因素、生殖结构异常、免疫功能障碍、感染因素、内分泌功能紊乱等，此外仍有约50%的患者病因不明确[2]，被称为不明原因复发性流产(unexplained recurrent pregnancy loss，URPL)。蛋白质翻译后修饰(post-translational modifications，PTMs)指通过在蛋白质的氨基酸侧链上共价结合修饰基团或通过蛋白质水解剪去基团而调节蛋白质活性、改变蛋白质性质[3-4]。大多数PTMs动态可逆，通过特定的酶[例如乙酰化情况下的乙酰转移酶(histone acetyltransferase 1，HAT)和脱乙酰酶(histone deacetylase，HDAC)，泛素情况下的泛素连接酶和去泛素化酶)]从多肽链上添加或移除[5]。迄今为止已经发现300余种PTMs形式，包括磷酸化、乙酰化、泛素化、甲基化和琥珀酸化等[6]。PTMs在URPL的发生、发展中发挥重要作用。本文梳理URPL背景下，磷酸化、甲基化、乙酰化、泛素化、糖基化和乳酸化的相关文献，总结PTMs在URPL病理机制中的作用，旨在阐明PTMs与URPL之间的关系，为URPL的诊疗提供启示。 甲基化 组蛋白甲基化是在蛋白质分子上添加甲基基团的PTMs过程，主要发生在H3和H4组蛋白N端赖氨酸和精氨酸残基上，以调节组蛋白和非组蛋白功能，参与癌症、衰老和生殖系统疾病的发生、发展[7]。组蛋白赖氨酸甲基化由组蛋白赖氨酸甲基转移酶(histone lysine methyltransferase，HKMT)介导，可表现为单甲基化、二甲基化或三甲基化3种状态[8]。HKMT是包括SET结构域的蛋白质家族，除能使H3K79甲基化的Dot1酶外，所有HKMT都有1个SET结构域。根据其对底物的不同作用，HKMTs可被归纳为激活基因转录和抑制基因转录2种类别[9]。组蛋白精氨酸甲基化由组蛋白精氨酸甲基转移酶(protein arginine methyltransferase，PRMT)介导，目前在哺乳动物中鉴定出对称性二甲基精氨酸、非对称性二甲基精氨酸和亚甲基精氨酸3种主要的甲基-精氨酸形式[10]。在URPL中蛋白质甲基化主要发挥阻碍蜕膜化、调控滋养层细胞迁移和侵袭的作用。 阻碍蜕膜化 子宫内膜间质蜕膜形成缺陷是URPL的潜在病因。子宫内膜蜕膜化伴随着全基因组组蛋白修饰。Tang等[11]建立体外诱导蜕膜化细胞模型，发现使用H3K27去甲基化特异性有效抑制剂后蜕膜标志基因PRL和IGFBP1的表达下调，这证实组蛋白甲基化对蜕膜化的调控作用。胰岛素样生长因子2(insulin-like growth factor 2，IGF2)位于相邻染色体位点，可编码胎儿有丝分裂原，是最早发现的内源性印记基因。印记基因缺失与许多以异常生长表型和行为障碍为特征的疾病有关[12]。在URPL患者蜕膜组织中，IGF2印记基因丢失，其机制为印迹控制区CTCF结合位点通过多肽缺失蛋白2募集多梳抑制复合物2，引起等位基因IGF2的启动子区域(P2，P3)H3K27甲基化，并使母体IGF2沉默[13]。 调控滋养层细胞迁移和侵袭 滋养层细胞在妊娠早期母胎界面的发育过程中起重要作用，其增殖和侵袭能力受损是URPL的另一病因。果蝇Zeste基因增强子人类同源物2(enhancer of Zeste homolog 2，EZH2)是一种转录抑制因子，可通过抑制靶基因表达改变细胞的生物学行为。EZH2作用于H3K27并催化其甲基化形成H3K27me3，从而影响染色质构型和基因组稳定性[14]。研究[15]发现：EZH2催化的H3K27me3若在胱抑素C(cystatin C，CST3)启动子区域大量募集则直接与CST3启动子结合而抑制CST3基因表达，促进滋养层细胞增殖、迁移和侵袭，反之抑制滋养层细胞活性，导致URPL发生。因此，组蛋白H3K27甲基化对URPL蜕膜化及滋养层迁移和侵袭进程中相关基因的表达具有重要调控作用。然而目前涉及蜕膜化进程中组蛋白甲基化修饰的研究有限，未来需要更多机制研究探索其在调控蜕膜化进程中的关键作用。 磷酸化 蛋白质磷酸化是指磷酸基团与蛋白质连接，主要发生于丝氨酸、苏氨酸和酪氨酸残基，并通过磷酸化和去磷酸化激活/灭活多种酶和受体，以调节细胞信号转导、蛋白质生物学活性及细胞定位[6]，在真核生物中普遍存在，具有可逆性和稳定性[16]。在生殖医学领域，Cui等[17]在HeLa细胞中鉴定出560多个组氨酸磷酸化位点。在URPL中，蛋白质磷酸化主要发挥干扰免疫耐受、调控滋养层细胞凋亡的作用。 干扰免疫耐受 成功的妊娠需要平衡的免疫反应，大约15%的子宫蜕膜细胞是免疫细胞，主要由自然杀伤细胞、巨噬细胞(macrophages，Mφs)、树突状细胞(dendritic cells，DCs)和T淋巴细胞等组成。母胎界面促炎和抗炎免疫反应平衡是维持正常妊娠的关键一环，不同细胞类型间的平衡状态有助于母胎界面免疫耐受环境的建立。子宫DCs是负责抗原呈递的细胞之一，具有诱导免疫反应和特异性免疫耐受的独特能力，被认为在母体识别父系抗原的微妙平衡中起关键作用，其分布、成熟状态异常或功能障碍都可能对妊娠结局产生不良影响[18]。Zhu等[19]研究URPL患者外周血单核细胞和蜕膜组织发现：磷酸化信号转导及转录激活因子(signal transduction and activator of transcription，STAT)3受高表达的miR-6875-5p负向调控，引起浆细胞样DCs的分化减少，诱发母胎界面免疫失衡，导致URPL发生。蜕膜Mφs是蜕膜免疫细胞的第二大群体(占10%~20%)，目前普遍认为着床初期以M1型Mφs(M1-Mφs)为主导，创造有利于着床的促炎环境，后逐渐转变为M2型Mφs(M2-Mφs)主导的免疫耐受平衡稳态。在M2-Mφs的细胞核中，STAT6与SEC5相互作用，SEC5表达下调抑制STAT6磷酸化，遏制蜕膜Mφs向M2-Mφs极化，进一步干扰母胎界面免疫耐受，导致早期流产[20]。母体CD4+ T细胞为母胎界面免疫微环境的重要组成部分，调节性T细胞(regulatory T cells，Treg)和辅助性T细胞17(T helper 17 cells，Th17)是其独立亚群，参与维持妊娠母胎免疫耐受平衡[21]。STAT3作为一种细胞内转录因子，可被细胞质酪氨酸激酶(Janus kinase，JAK)激活并磷酸化，随后进入细胞核激活靶基因的转录和表达。磷酸化STAT3(phosphorylation STAT3，pSTAT3)与Th17、Treg的分化和平衡相关。研究[22]发现：URPL患者蜕膜CD4+ T细胞中pSTAT3水平显著高于正常孕妇，高表达的pSTAT3抑制Treg细胞增殖，打破母胎界面的Treg和Th17平衡，干扰母胎界面免疫耐受，导致妊娠丢失。 pmc-12042129.title: Enhancing neurogenesis after traumatic brain injury: The role of adenosine kinase inhibition in promoting neuronal survival and differentiation
pmc-12042129.creator: Andrea Campbell, Tho Lai, Amir E Wahba, Detlev Boison, Hoda M Gebril
pmc-12042129.description: Traumatic brain injury (TBI) presents a significant public health challenge, necessitating innovative interventions for effective treatment. Recent studies have challenged conventional perspectives on neurogenesis, unveiling endogenous repair mechanisms within the adult brain following injury. However, the intricate mechanisms governing post-TBI neurogenesis remain unclear.

pmc-12363051.title: How local health departments use wastewater surveillance data for public health planning and intervention in New York State
pmc-12363051.creator: Shailla Raymond, Mila Neyra, Dustin T Hill, Ainsley Maclachlan, Jordan McGuire, Matthew Mahaney, Nicole Pulido, Bhavneet Walia, Nan Yang, Yifan Zhu, Yiquan Zhou, David A Larsen
pmc-12363051.description: Wastewater surveillance presents a novel data stream for local health departments to understand infectious disease risk in their communities. We conducted a survey of local health departments in New York State regarding their knowledge, attitudes, and practices toward wastewater surveillance of SARS-CoV-2.

pmc-12653507.title: Clinical Characteristics and Surgical Outcomes of Bilateral Sequential Rhegmatogenous Retinal Detachment
pmc-12653507.creator: Ida Gordon, Ndeye Coumba Ndiaye, Karine Angioi-Duprez, Jean-Paul Berrod, Jean-Baptiste Conart
pmc-12653507.description: Objectives: To compare the clinical characteristics and surgical outcomes of initial and subsequent eyes in patients with sequential, bilateral rhegmatogenous retinal detachment (RRD). Design: Single-center observational retrospective cohort study. Methods: Sixty-eight patients who underwent surgery for sequential, bilateral RRD between January 2016 and December 2023 were included. Baseline characteristics, surgical procedures and postoperative outcomes were collected for both eyes.

pmc-12741442.title: Sorafenib-associated Trichodysplasia Spinulosa versus Follicular Hyperkeratosis: a case report
pmc-12741442.creator: Reem Hasan, Nemat Alsaghir, Kinda Alshawa, Sajeda Alnabelsi, Hanaa Almsokar
pmc-12741442.description: Sorafenib is a multi-target kinase inhibitor used to treat advanced cancers, such as hepatocellular carcinoma. It has been associated with various cutaneous adverse events and here we report a new potential skin reaction—Trichodysplasia Spinulosa (TS)—and explore its differential diagnosis with Follicular Hyperkeratosis (FH), both possibly induced by Sorafenib.

pmc-13099313.title: Perspective: from pathogenesis to treatment in veterinary science through organoid disease modelling
pmc-13099313.creator: Bo Chen, Ron Slocombe, Smitha Rose Georgy
pmc-13099313.description: Organoid technology is emerging as a powerful platform for in vitro disease modelling in veterinary research. Although veterinary organoid models have been established across multiple species and organ systems, most studies remain largely descriptive, with a predominant focus on model development rather than disease mechanisms or therapeutic relevance.

pmc-13247042.title: Realization of fermionic Laughlin state on a quantum processor
pmc-13247042.creator: Lingnan Shen, Mao Lin, Cedric Yen-Yu Lin, Di Xiao, Ting Cao
pmc-13247042.description: Strongly correlated topological phases of matter are central to modern condensed matter physics and quantum information technology but often challenging to probe and control in material systems. The experimental difficulty of accessing these phases has motivated the use of engineered quantum platforms for simulation and manipulation of exotic topological states.

pmc-13546361.title: Organ dose assessment in 15-year-old patients undergoing panoramic radiography: a Monte Carlo study using mesh-type phantoms and realistic modelling
pmc-13546361.creator: Maria Rosangela Soares, Wilson Otto Batista, Jacqueline Machado Gurjão Rios
pmc-13546361.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). This study evaluated organ-specific absorbed doses and sex-dependent dosimetric variations in 15-year-old patients undergoing panoramic radiography across different units technologies. ICRP 156 mesh-type reference computational phantoms (MRCPs) were coupled with the PHITS Monte Carlo code for this analysis. Three panoramic units with distinct kinematics and exposure protocols were simulated: Unit A (fixed isocentric rotation, constant parameters) and Units B and C (sliding rotation axis, dynamic kV/mA modulation). Absolute absorbed doses were estimated using experimentally derived air kerma-area product conversion factors.

pmc-13571455.title: Response to: ‘Re-assessing the clinical significance of long-term neuromuscular alterations following onabotulinumtoxinA in chronic migraine’
pmc-13571455.creator: Tina Plensäll, Maarika Liik, Artor Pogosean, Annika Eriksson, Malin Garrett, Jan Olszowy, Sven Jackmann, Anna Rostedt Punga
pmc-13571455.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). e and that extensive trial and real-world evidence supports its continued clinical use. Indeed, our own cohort demonstrated a significant and sustained reduction in migraine days (Plensäll et al., 2026). Our study was not intended to challenge the established benefit-risk profile of BoNTA or to discourage its use, but to characterize and highlight neuromuscular effects that may not be captured by conventional efficacy and general safety outcomes. We respectfully disagree, however, that our findings should be regarded exclusively as subclinical.
